questions.question: Which of the following carboxylic acids is most acidic in character
questions.explanation:
• -CH₃ is an electron-donating group, so at meta and para it decreases acidity (m- and p-methyl benzoic acids are less acidic than benzoic acid).

  • But at the ortho position, steric hindrance between -COOH and -CH₃ leads to:

    • Less resonance between -COOH and the ring in the conjugate base

    • Better solvation of the -COO⁻ ion

This "ortho effect" increases acidity, so:

o-methyl benzoic acid > benzoic acid > m- & p-methyl benzoic acids
